text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"'The Golden Warrior faces his fateful nemesis once more!
Which way will the scales of destiny tip!?
—To Be Continued!'"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uwooo~! What's gonna happen to the warrior?
I gotta watch the rest soon!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what!? Is it really this late already!?
Do I have no choice but to wrap it up for today...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
……Noooo!
Seeing a match through to the end is justice too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Biko Pegasus kept watching
tokusatsu dramas one after another,
ending up staying up late into the night.
